sources.headline: Kevin Stefanski on Michael Penix's rib injury: We'll know more as we get imaging
sources.description: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski did not have much of an update on Michael Penix Jr. immediately after Sunday's loss to the Ravens after the quarterback suffered a rib injury late in the fourth quarter.

sources.name: NFL.com
sources.headline: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) says injury isn't long term, will be OK
sources.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. exited Sunday night's loss to the Baltimore Ravens with a ribs injury. Backup QB Tua Tagovaila replaced Penix.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.headline: Michael Penix: If we got ball first in OT, I could have stayed in
sources.description: The final play of Sunday night's game saw Falcons backup quarterback Tua Tagovailoa throw an interception to seal the Ravens' 30-23 overtime win while starter Michael Penix watched from the sideline with a rib injury.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.headline: Kevin Stefanski: We'll have a better idea Wednesday about Michael Penix
sources.description: Multiple reports on Monday said that Falcons quarterback Michael Penix avoided a serious injury to his ribs when he was hurt late in Sunday night's loss to the Ravens, but head coach Kevin Stefanski isn't ready to make any comments about his availability for Week 6.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.headline: Falcons expect Michael Penix to practice Wednesday
sources.description: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix was confident he avoided a serious rib injury when he was hurt on Sunday night and nothing's changed about that outlook in the last couple of days.

sources.headline: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) expected to start Week 6 vs. Bears
sources.description: The Atlanta Falcons may have avoided disaster. Quarterback Michael Penix Jr. (rib) is expected to start in Atlanta's Week 6 game against Chicago.

sources.headline: 'I’ve Sat Out Enough': Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. On Track to Start vs. Bears
sources.description: Quarterback Michael Penix Jr. is on track to start for the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6 against the Chicago Bears.

sources.headline: Michael Penix fully participated in Wednesday's practice
sources.description: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said before Wednesday's practice that quarterback Michael Penix would participate, but that he would "be limited in some fashion" due to his injured ribs.
